sections.aboutPreview: Computer Engineering student, full-stack engineer and relentless problem-solver. I obsess over clean architecture, measurable impact and software that scales — and I bring sharp communication from years of podcasting and hosting.

faq.a: A full-stack, Python and AI developer based in Ahmedabad, India. I build scalable web apps, data pipelines and AI automation — turning repetitive, manual processes into reliable software.
React and Next.js frontends, secure Node.js and Python backends, high-volume ETL pipelines, OCR and LLM automation, and eCommerce platforms with payments — end to end.

faq.q: Which AI technologies does Darshan work with?
faq.a: OpenAI, Mistral AI, OCR services, Llama 3.1 with Unsloth and QLoRA, prompt engineering and multi-model LLM orchestration, plus Python automation around them.

faq.q: Is Darshan available for full-stack or AI opportunities?
faq.a: Yes — open to full-stack and AI/automation roles and collaborations. Reach out and let's talk about what you're building.

faq.q: Where can I view Darshan's projects?
faq.a: The Work page lists 16 shipped projects with tags and links. Code for several is on GitHub at github.com/darshansatapara.
